summary: Sequence (BRSEQ) player: owns the 16 Sound_SeqChannel objects, the loaded bank and wave-archive handles, the async file request and the loaded sequence data, and drives the per-frame tempo/note update. Embedded in a Sound_Player slot.
evidence: Vtable 0x00781C38 (5 slots, all Sound_SeqPlayer_*/Sound_Track_* methods). The class is the "sequence player" half of the sound library: Sound_SeqPlayer_Update (0x00555308) runs the open->load->play state machine, PlayFrame (0x00555878) and ComputeTempoStep (0x005549EC) advance the 16 channels, and BindChannels (0x005551F8) fills the channel array from the owning Sound_Player. Size 0x21FC comes from the highest strong field (+0x21F8, u16).

summary: One MIDI-style sequence channel of a Sound_SeqPlayer: owns a linked list of Sound_SeqNote objects, five interpolation envelopes (volume, expression, pan, pitch, key shift), the per-channel DSP parameter block that is copied onto every note, and the output mode.
evidence: Vtable stored by Sound_SeqChannel_Dtor (0x0054EE94) from DAT_0054EF08; Sound_SeqPlayer_BindChannels (0x005551F8) creates one per set bit of the channel mask and stores it in the player's 16-entry channel array at +0x90. Sound_SeqChannel_ApplyMixParams (0x0054E37C) reads the five envelope pairs and copies +0xAC..+0xEF onto every note, Sound_SeqChannel_Tick (0x0054E130) advances the envelope positions. Size 0x134 = highest strong field +0x130 (note list head) + 4.

summary: One playing sequencer note: owns a Sound_Voice, a four-entry 0x20-byte envelope array at +0xB4, the volume/fade ramp and a completion callback; filled from a note record by Sound_SeqNote_SetupVoices and driven per frame by Sound_SeqNote_Update.
evidence: Sound_SeqNote_SetupVoices (0x00555EE4) copies the record timing/scale into +0x78..+0x84 and installs per-voice buffers; Sound_SeqNote_Start (0x005561BC) resets the four 0x20-byte envelopes at +0xB4, sets +0x139 and calls Sound_Voice_SetupStreams(note->f_1a8); Sound_SeqNote_Update (0x0055624C) interpolates the volume ramp at +0x180..+0x18C and the fade at +0x164..+0x170; Sound_SeqNote_Release (0x0055614C) stops the voice and invokes the callback at +0x1A0. Size 428 is max_strong_field+width (+0x1A8 + 4).

fields.name: maybe_ownerNote
fields.evidence: Sound_SeqNote_FindNoteInRange reads `note->f_c->f_1a8` (voice), `f_1a0` (callback) and `f_1a4`, and walks a 0x30-byte sub-note record array at the pointed-to object; the field is probably inherited from the Sound_Voice base.

fields.name: maybe_isHeld

fields.name: isPlaying

fields.name: maybe_isPooled

fields.name: maybe_isFadeOnForce

fields.name: maybe_isPaused
